source.title: A communication subspace relays context-dependent actions from human prefrontal to motor cortex

confidence_rationale: Peer-reviewed (Nature Neuroscience, epub 2026-05-01, in print Jul 2026), verified via PubMed (PMID 42067701); citation in the thought's reference list is exact. It adds the two things Semedo lacks: human data, and a BEHAVIOURAL readout -- the subspace predicts context-dependent action at the single-trial level better than either region's full activity. That is closer to MECH-537's phenotype than any other biological source in the package. Held at 0.68 because n=12 intracranial patients, the analysis is on field-potential-scale recordings rather than sorted units, and 'predicts action better than either area alone' is a statement about prediction, not about a distinction being withheld from the consumer.
failure_signatures: If the full PFC population had predicted action at least as well as its communication subspace, the claim that the interface FILTERS rather than merely transmits would lose its human anchor; the paper reports the subspace predicting better, but only in 12 patients on one target-detection task.
A REE interface metric that reads off the consumer's full input rather than the RRR-estimated subspace would not reproduce this result and would not be testing the same object.

mapping.source_claim_statement: Using intracranial recordings from human prefrontal cortex and motor cortex, the authors identify a communication subspace embedded within high-dimensional PFC activity that selectively relays behaviourally relevant information at the single-trial level; activity in this subspace predicts context-dependent action more strongly than either region alone.
mapping.ree_translation: ARC-139's claim that a low-dimensional interface can carry what a consumer needs while the sender remains high-dimensional and privately rich is here shown in a human, with a behavioural criterion. For MECH-537 it is the closest published instance of the interface being the thing that predicts behaviour rather than the sender's full state -- i.e. the consumer-facing subspace is the behaviourally load-bearing object.
mapping.mapping_caveat: Predicting action BETTER from the subspace than from either full population is not the same as showing a variable that is present in PFC but absent from the subspace with a behavioural cost. The paper demonstrates selective relay of relevant information, not the routing FAILURE MECH-537 names. Small n (12 epilepsy patients), clinical electrode placement, and one task; the authors themselves flag the sample size.
mapping.source_context: 12 patients with drug-resistant epilepsy, intracranial recordings from PFC and M1, contextually cued target-detection task.

confidence_components.notes: Nature Neuroscience with released code (github nehabinish/pfc-m1-communication-subspace, simulated data only). Small clinical sample limits source quality slightly. Mapping mid: right object, right direction, wrong side of the failure/success distinction.
